sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Nausea; vomiting of food several hours
after eating; of sweetish water in the morning. Feeling
of coldness, as of ice water in stomach. Soreness; bet-
ter eating. Painful hard spot. Hsematemesis. Bitter
taste after a swallow of water.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Distended. Burning haemorrhoids. Diar-
rhoea ; very offensive ; dark brown. Bloody, fetid stools.
Cholera infantum in connection with painful dentition,
green stools, nausea, dry skin, exhaustion, etc.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Offensive. Violent itching of vulva and
vagina, worse when urinating. Can urinate only when
lying; cannot get out of bed quick enough during first

sections.label: sleep
sections.text:
Dreams of urinating. Enuresis in the first part
of night. Must hun-y vehen desire comes to urinate.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Corrosive itching within vulva, burning and
swelling of labia ; violent itching between labia and
thighs. During menses, difficult hearing; buzzing and
roaring; eruption after. Burning and soreness in ex-

sections.label: Head
sections.text: Sticking pains in different parts of head and

sections.label: face
sections.text:
Dull pain in right upper jaw. Stiff neck. Sud-
den cricks in neck, pains more severe behind ears.
Pain in muscles of neck when lifting head from pillow.
Fullness in ears, ringing in head.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Tongue dry, rough, sore. Throat painful
on swallowing. Nausea.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Lewd dreams. Sexual desire lost. Re-
establishes suppressed gonorrhoea.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Rheumatic pains. General tired and
sick feeling. Palms rough and scaly.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Dry, itching eczema. Erythema around roots
of nails. Skin dry, wrinkled. Painful cracks. Warty
growths. Nails thicken. Psoriasis.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:

night; open air.
